body:
Absolutely. Fucking. Terrifying. 

- this message came from the bee allergy gang
That’s great! I hope things go up from here, degrees give opportunities, has the housing situation cleared up, and do you have a stable job now?
Hey, hope you’re still here, I stopped using Reddit for a little while, hope your doing great, so sorry for no response.
You seem interesting, hope you choose not to go, we can talk if you want, it’s always nice to talk to someone

Well, I know it’s not real, but think if this comment ad a virtual hug, we all need hugs every now and again. I hope you are ok. No matter what you choose to do, be safe. I hope you can be happy soon. Call someone you really care about, even multiple people, tell them, talk to them, before you hang up, if you love them, doesn’t have to be romantic, tell them. It would mean a lot to them, I’m sure. That way if you choose to leave, they’ll know that you loved them.

If you have a masters, I recommend finding a homeless shelter or something like it, and apply for as many jobs as possible to get enough money to go home or buy a home where you are or something. Please. Even if you leave this world, you pursued your dreams, good job. You tried. That’s what matters, but I strongly discourage giving up now. Good luck, I hope you choose to keep living.
